name: DoorDash Scraper API
description: DoorDash scraper for Python and the command line: restaurants delivering in a US city, with rating, exact review count, cuisine, price band, address, delivery fee, delivery time, promotions and popular menu items with prices, as JSON or CSV. Free and open source; sign in with your QuanticData account, no proxies or headless browser to run.

commands.name: restaurants
commands.help: DoorDash restaurants delivering in a US city
commands.description: Restaurants delivering in a US city — rating, exact review count, cuisine, address.

inputs.name: location
inputs.description: US city and state, e.g. "Austin, TX".

inputs.name: cuisine
inputs.description: Narrow to one cuisine, e.g. "mexican" or "sushi". Each cuisine has its own list for the city, so running several cuisines covers more restaurants.

inputs.name: country
inputs.description: Country to run the request from, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (us, gb, de...).

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: How many restaurants to deliver at most (1–50). You pay only for delivered restaurants.
